items.title: 5 Dead in Amazon Cargo Plane Crash at Miami International Airport
items.summary: Officials said five people have died and five more were injured after an Amazon cargo flight overran the runway at Miami International Airport and crashed after landing there in the afternoon.  "We can confirm that an Amazon Air plane operated by 21 Air experienced an incident while attempting to land at Miami International Airport today," Amazon spokesperson Kelly Nantel said in an email.  Officials announced the deaths during a televised press conference.
